why: Mixed review: 34:56-1:00:51 (~26 min, the most) drills verb + preposition pairs in her English-to-Arabic sentences (16:38 'Do you remember how to say apologise to?', 35:55 't2assaffi la-awal 7ada', 43:34 'enza3ajti min 7ada'), and 19:42-34:56 (~15 min) goes over his homework on the tool words awal / aa5er / taani / nafs (26:28 'my last time, my first time, it's all marra'). 01:52-19:42 is warm-up talk (a van accident, the holiday, date, clothes); Medi's audio is missing 12:07-17:36, only her side is transcribed. Nothing new was set except a few words and two small rules (عن = on behalf of at 40:42, last night = ليلة امبارح at 53:57).

on behalf of / for (someone who should have done it): أنا بزعل عنك, اشتغلت عنك

monster / beast (not 'wild' about a person; Medi said وحشي)

summary.headline: Review: verb + preposition pairs in sentences, and homework on awal / aa5er / taani / nafs

rules.title: Each feeling verb takes its own little word: bat2assaf la-, btetdaaya2 min, byet7ammas la-, ba5aaf 3ala
bullets: the verb decides the little word, learn them as pairs
la- = towards (apologise to, excited for, miss)

examples.line: t2assaffi la-awal 7ada inti betshufih - apologise to the first person you see
fi ishi taani inti btetdaaya2i minno? - is there anything else you're upset about?
aimta aa5er marra enza3ajti min 7ada? - when was the last time you got annoyed with someone?
abuy byet7ammas la-el-5areef - my father gets excited for the fall
ana shta2et la-ijaazaati - I missed my vacations
ana ba5aaf 3ala eben 3ammi - I worry about my cousin

rules.title: عن = doing it on someone's behalf: ana baz3al 3annak, shta8alet 3annak
bullets: use عن when they should have done it, but you did
not 'worked for you' as an employer

examples.line: أنا بزعل عنك - I'm upset for you (you should be)
أنا اشتغلت عنك - I worked in your place

rules.title: Time = marra: aa5er marra, awal marra (not marra el-a5eera)
bullets: a time or a turn is marra, not wa2et
aa5er goes before the noun, no el-
il-marra el-a5eera works, marra el-a5eera does not

examples.line: my last time, my first time, it's all marra
haadi ra7 tkoon aa5er marra ili honaak - this will be my last time there
imta aa5er marra - when was the last time

rules.title: Tool words on the homework: el-taani after the noun, nafs + noun, awal + noun
bullets: the second one = el-taani after the noun
the same place as this = nafs makaan haada

examples.line: 7ajezna el-taani mish nafs makaan haada - our second booking is not in the same place as this one
awal sayyaara la-s7aabi kanat zar2a - my friend's first car was blue
aa5er shu8ul ilhom kaan mut3eb / beyta33eb - their last job was tiring

rules.title: Last night = lailet mbaare7; aa5er = last in a row, maadi = past
bullets: aa5er lailet means the final night, not yesterday
for time both aa5er marra and el-marra el-maadye work

examples.line: ليلة امبارح أو امبارح بالليل - last night
lailet mbaare7 ana kunet mit7ammes la-arja3 3ala el-bait - last night I was excited to get back home

rules.title: Own business: tabe3 agrees with the noun: sharike tab3ti
bullets: شركة is feminine, so it takes تبعتي

examples.line: شركة because it's feminine, you would say تبعتي
